baseline_models.focus_anchor: The active participle شَاهِد and passive participle مَشْهُود repeat one root in two grammatical orientations.
baseline_models.mechanism: The paired forms distribute one witnessing event across a present perceiver and an entity or event made present to perception. Their indefiniteness keeps both occupants open while making the relation itself stable.

activation_trace.role: Direct presence with seeing supplies the shared scene that links the active witness to the passive witnessed party.

changed_reading.before: The phrase merely lists an observer and an observed object.
changed_reading.after: The phrase foregrounds an open relational scene: presence is divided into the one attending and that which is attended, without yet fixing either identity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: شَاهِد is agentive while مَشْهُود is the passive pole of the same root, allowing knowledge to move from a knower toward something publicly established.
baseline_models.mechanism: Witnessing is not exhausted by looking. Knowledge is declared, acknowledged, or judged, and the passive counterpart becomes the matter borne out by that declaration.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge-based testimony turns the active noun into an attester and the passive noun into a matter established as evidence.

changed_reading.after: Witnessing is an evidentiary conversion in which known experience is made declarative and a person, event, or claim becomes attestable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same ش ه د root can name a visible sign, while the active-passive pairing can distribute indication between marker and disclosed condition.
baseline_models.mechanism: A perceivable marker bears witness to a time, state, or quality; what is witnessed is the otherwise unarticulated condition made legible through that marker.

activation_trace.role: A visible sign that indicates time, state, or quality supplies a semiotic relation between marker and disclosed condition.

changed_reading.before: The nouns must denote animate witnesses and observed persons.
changed_reading.after: They can also denote an indicating sign and the time, state, or quality that the sign renders readable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated coordinated sequence moves from an overarching spatial order, to a bounded or appointed time, to the witness-witnessed relation. This makes the relation itself an invoked guarantor rather than requiring immediate identification of two figures.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge-based testimony gives the final pair evidentiary force within the coordinated opening.
The sky as what rises and overshadows supplies the first large-scale object invoked in the sequence.
A delimited duration supplies the temporal member parallel to the spatial and evidentiary members.
An appointment fixed to time or place turns the day into a guaranteed rendezvous rather than an unspecified date.

structural_cues: 85:1-3 repeat initial coordination and genitive-marked nouns as one opening series.
The sequence progresses from spatial order to appointed time to an epistemic relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the parallel opening sequence and branches of overarching space, duration, appointment, and testimony. I infer that coordination makes each member an invoked guarantor and that the final guarantor is a relation, not a named individual. A live alternative is a simple list whose witness identities must be supplied elsewhere.

changed_reading.before: The pair is an isolated riddle asking which witness and which witnessed object are meant.
changed_reading.after: The pair invokes the reliability of witnessing itself beside ordered space and appointed time; open identity is functional rather than defective.

context_deltas.mechanism: A split mapping activates the sky as a marked surface read by an observer, the celestial towers provide its visible articulation, and a second split mapping activates counted recurring time. The witness-witnessed pair can therefore operate as index and indexed event across a cosmic calendar.

activation_trace.role: The witnessing sign supplies the focus-level link between a visible index and the condition or time it discloses.
The non-dominant mapped image of a mark from which an observer reads a state recasts the sky as an interpretable surface.
Celestial towers provide differentiated visible stations on that marked surface.
The non-dominant mapped image of counted, recurring time supplies a calendrical rhythm to the promised event.

structural_cues: Sky, celestial stations, an appointed day, and the witness pair occur consecutively.
The active-passive focus pair leaves room for marker and indexed event rather than only observer and person.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible celestial differentiation, a mark read as a state, recurring counted time, and the focus sign branch. I infer an index-to-event arrow linking what can be read above to what is due in time. A live alternative is that the cosmic and temporal terms are parallel oath objects without a calendrical mechanism between them.

changed_reading.before: A witnessing sign indicates only a local present condition.
changed_reading.after: The witness can be a cosmic-temporal index, while the witnessed is the appointed event whose approach or certainty the index makes legible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The trench supplies a bounded scene, deliberate sitting supplies sustained surveillance, and the later شُهُود are present over their own action. Presence is therefore not neutral: the observers' stable attention binds them to the violence they perform.

activation_trace.role: Presence with direct seeing supplies the focus relation whose ethical valence the later scene changes.
A long deep incision localizes the spectacle and gives the witnesses a concrete scene over which to remain.
Sitting for watch or ambush makes their presence sustained and purposive rather than accidental.
The production of an act ties the observed event back to the observers as its agents.
The plural witnesses are explicitly present with seeing over what they themselves do, closing the agency-observation loop.

structural_cues: 85:6 places them seated over the fire; 85:7 places them over what they do to the believers.
The observer and agent are grammatically the same group in 85:7.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a deep scene, purposive watching, an enacted deed, and plural direct witnesses. I infer sustained watching plus agency leads to culpable participation rather than detached observation. A live alternative is that شُهُود only reports eyewitness status without assigning extra liability.

changed_reading.before: The witness is presumptively a detached and reliable observer.
changed_reading.after: The witness can be the perpetrating spectator, and the witnessed event is simultaneously spectacle, deed, and evidence against those who watched it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Incision, branding fire, and consumable fuel make violence materially transformative. The witnessed event is not only retained by a mind; it writes itself into ground, bodies, and residue as a sign-bearing scene.

activation_trace.role: A visible sign that discloses a condition lets physical traces function as witnesses.
The deep linear cut supplies an inscription-like alteration of the ground.
Kindled fire together with branding supplies both destructive heat and the production of a lasting mark.
Fuel as consumed material makes the scene a process that leaves transformed matter behind.

structural_cues: 85:4-5 juxtapose the cut trench, fire, and fuel as one material apparatus.
مَشْهُود is morphologically open to an event or object that has been made perceptible.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cutting, branding fire, fuel, and a sign-bearing focus branch. I infer material transformation produces traces that continue to testify after observers leave. A live alternative is that trench, fire, and fuel only describe the setting and do not form a record mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Evidence survives only as a witness's remembered report.
changed_reading.after: The witnessed scene can become its own material witness: incision, scorch, and residue preserve the event in altered matter.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fire supplies visible flare, faith supplies inward security and assent, and fitna supplies the assay of metal or person. Under pressure, an inward orientation becomes outwardly readable; the ordeal produces a sign but does not confer truth on the persecutors who impose it.

activation_trace.role: The witnessing sign supplies the transition from hidden condition to visible indication.
Clarity and emergence into view make the fire scene an engine of visibility as well as injury.
Heart-settling assent supplies the inward quality that persecution attempts to expose or overturn.
Assaying metal or a person supplies the test mechanism by which latent quality becomes manifest.

structural_cues: The believers are acted upon because of an inward commitment named in 85:8.
The fire vocabulary recurs around the root whose inventory includes assay.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inward trust, visible fire, assay, and indication. I infer pressure leads to manifestation of a previously hidden commitment; I do not infer that violence validates the assayer. A live alternative is that fitna here contributes torment alone and no revelation mechanism.

changed_reading.before: A witness merely notices a condition already visible.
changed_reading.after: The witnessing relation can include a pressure-driven disclosure: the witnessed is a latent commitment made visible by ordeal, while the resulting sign indicts the coercive test.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sovereignty supplies reach, totality supplies exhaustive scope, the thing is whatever can be known and reported, and شَهِيد supplies knowledge-based testimony. The open focus pair expands into an asymmetrical relation between comprehensive witness and every attestable entity or event.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge-based testimony provides the evidentiary relation whose scope is enlarged in 85:9.
Sovereign rule supplies unrestricted jurisdiction for the act of witnessing.
Encircling completeness makes the witnessing scope exhaustive rather than selective.
A thing as something knowable and reportable supplies the unrestricted passive field of testimony.
The explicit knowledgeable witness joins comprehensive scope to decisive attestation.

structural_cues: 85:9 places witness language after possession of heavens and earth and over every thing.
The focus pair remains indefinite, so this contextual realization need not exhaust other occupants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sovereignty, exhaustive totality, knowable things, and explicit testimony. I infer jurisdiction plus total scope leads to comprehensive evidentiary presence. A live alternative is that 85:9 names one particular witness realization without semantically expanding مَشْهُود in 85:3 to all things.

changed_reading.before: The witness-witnessed relation is a bounded encounter between two local participants.
changed_reading.after: One live realization is comprehensive and asymmetrical: sovereign testimony ranges over every knowable thing as its witnessed field.

context_deltas.mechanism: Appointment guarantees an event before arrival, concealment under dense growth makes a real good not fully exposed, and flowing beneath places part of it outside direct sight. The direct-presence baseline is broadened from current visibility to secured future or hidden witnessability.

activation_trace.role: Direct presence with viewing supplies the baseline whose exclusivity is challenged by deferred and concealed realities.
A fixed appointment secures an encounter that is not yet present.
Covering and concealment supply a real domain whose contents need not be immediately exposed.
Being beneath something gives the flowing reality an occluded spatial position.

structural_cues: The promised day precedes the focus pair, while the gardens and what flows beneath them follow later.
The packet combines future appointment with spatial concealment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a fixed future encounter, concealment, and an under-layer. I infer guaranteed reality can become an object of witness before full visual disclosure, weakening a strictly ocular reading. A live alternative is that the focus pair refers only to a scene of actual co-presence when the appointment arrives.

changed_reading.before: مَشْهُود requires an object presently exposed to an attending eye.
changed_reading.after: The witnessed can be deferred or partly hidden yet secured for disclosure; witnessability is broader than immediate visibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: Force closes the first scene, while beginning-again and return reopen it. Because the focus leaves active and passive occupants unnamed, replay can reverse their positions: those who watched an inflicted event can become the objects exposed within a returned evidentiary scene.

activation_trace.role: The open attester-attested relation permits contextual reassignment of its active and passive occupants.
Seizure by overpowering force supplies the mechanism that can place former agents under judgment.
Beginning explicitly coupled with return supplies reopening rather than simple linear closure.
Return after departure and repetition after a beginning supplies the temporal replay needed for role reversal.

structural_cues: The focus uses complementary active and passive forms without named referents.
Earlier perpetrators are witnesses over their own act; later divine force, beginning, and return reopen the sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unnamed active-passive positions, culpable watchers, overpowering seizure, and beginning-with-return. I infer replay can reverse who occupies observer and observed positions. A live alternative is that beginning and return concern creation generally, with no juridical replay of the trench scene.

changed_reading.before: Witness and witnessed are fixed roles occupied once.
changed_reading.after: They are reversible positions across a returned scene: the watching agents can themselves become witnessed objects when the event is reopened for judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Companionship binds participants through sustained association, plural witnesses distribute seeing across the group, and an army is a mutually supporting collective. The singular indefinite focus noun can therefore name a witness-function instantiated by a coordinated body rather than only an isolated eye.

activation_trace.role: Presence with seeing supplies the function that can be distributed among multiple present members.
Companionship and sustained association bind the trench participants into a socially continuous group.
The plural witnesses instantiate shared presence and observation across that group.
A mutually supporting host supplies a second model of coordinated corporate agency.

structural_cues: The focus singular is followed by explicit plural شُهُود in 85:7.
Group labels frame both the trench actors and the later hosts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies associated companions, plural witnessing, and mutually supporting hosts. I infer repeated group structure distributes the witness-function without dissolving member responsibility. A live alternative is that the singular focus witness remains one individual and the plurals are separate contextual realizations.

changed_reading.after: It can name a distributed social function: a coordinated group sees, sustains, and answers for a shared witnessed scene.

context_deltas.mechanism: One branch covers truth and another assigns falsehood to a thing or speaker. These are opposed operations on testimony: evidence is present, but a receiving party masks it or attacks its credibility. Witnessing becomes a contested public relation rather than automatic persuasion.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge-based declaration supplies the testimony whose reception becomes contested.
Covering the truth supplies suppression of evidence without requiring the evidence to disappear.
Attributing falsehood to a claim or claimant supplies a direct attack on testimonial status.

structural_cues: 85:19 shifts with بَلْ from the preceding divine descriptions to people persisting inside denial.
The focus evidentiary pair does not grammatically guarantee acceptance by an audience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies testimony, truth-covering, and the attribution of falsehood. I infer concealment and discrediting act on the reception of evidence rather than erasing the witnessed reality. A live alternative is that disbelief and denial characterize a proposition generally, without modifying the focus relation.

changed_reading.before: Once testimony is given, the witnessed matter becomes socially settled.
changed_reading.after: Witness and witnessed can remain valid inside an adversarial field where truth is covered and the attester is called false.

context_deltas.mechanism: What is placed behind ordinary appearance is paired with complete encompassing knowledge and securing. The witness is no longer imagined at one viewing station opposite an object; witnessing surrounds the field, including its hidden rear.

activation_trace.role: Direct presence supplies the spatial model that enclosure expands beyond a single line of sight.
Placing something behind visibility supplies the ordinarily hidden side of the witnessed field.
Complete encompassing in knowledge and securing supplies observation with no exterior blind side.

structural_cues: 85:20 combines 'from behind them' with an encompassing predicate.
The focus pair marks relation but does not specify face-to-face geometry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a hidden-behind relation and complete encompassing knowledge. I infer enclosure defeats the visual blind spot and changes witness geometry from frontal observation to circumferential presence. A live alternative is that 'behind' only expresses pursuit or threat while witnessing remains ordinary observation.

changed_reading.before: A witness stands at one point and looks toward a separate object.
changed_reading.after: Witnessing can be circumferential: the witnessed is enclosed within knowledge, including what it places behind appearance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gathering and recitation organize articulate signs, a broad writing surface receives them, and guarding preserves both inscription and retained content. The focus relation can thus travel across media: tongue or visible expression, gathered recitation, written record, and protected memory.

activation_trace.role: The tongue or visible expression as a witness supplies the oral and semiotic starting medium.
Gathering and bringing together supplies the organization of separate signs into a coherent record.
Reading, recitation, and causing to read supply transmission through an articulate voice.
A broad board used for writing supplies the durable receiving surface.
Guarding and watchful preservation keep the witnessed content from loss or alteration.

structural_cues: The closing sequence places a recited collection in a written surface and qualifies it as preserved.
The focus inventory already allows the tongue or visible expression itself to serve as witness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies articulate witnessing, gathering-recitation, a writing board, and guarding. I infer a medium-change arrow from voiced sign to inscribed and preserved evidence. A live alternative is that the closing record is itself one witnessed object, without describing how the focus witness-function moves across media.

changed_reading.before: Testimony is an ephemeral encounter between a speaker and an event.
changed_reading.after: Witnessing can become a preservation chain: expression gathers the event into recitation, inscription receives it, and guarding sustains it as an enduring witnessed record.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the supplied ش ه د branch concerns bodily traces at birth or maturation and is form-distant from شَاهِد and مَشْهُود. It remains anchored in the exact focus root inventory, while beginning, coming-to-be, and emergent growth provide a visible transition mechanism. Downstream prose should present it only as a material-temporal echo, not as a lexical replacement for testimony.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The active-passive pairing can be tested against the supplied branch in which an emitted trace witnesses a hidden developmental threshold.

activation_trace.role: A bodily trace accompanying birth or maturation supplies an emitted sign of a transition otherwise hidden inside the body.
A newly appearing and remarkable thing supplies the threshold at which a latent state becomes manifest.
The emergence of growth or offspring supplies a generative analogue for a trace coming forth.
Coming into being after not being supplies the temporal change that the emitted sign registers.

changed_reading.before: Witnessing reports a fully formed event from outside it.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the witness may be an emergence trace produced by the event itself, while the witnessed is the hidden threshold of beginning or maturation that the trace makes legible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the honey-in-comb branch is lexically and materially distant from the two participles, and the extraction arrow is reader-supplied. It remains anchored in the packet's ش ه د inventory and gains limited support from concealment and guarded preservation. Downstream prose should call it a contained material analogy for evidence embedded in its carrier, never the primary sense of the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The shared ش ه د root includes honey retained in its comb before pressing, allowing a cautious analogy between witnessed content and the matrix that still holds it.

activation_trace.role: Honey remaining in the comb before pressing supplies valuable content still embedded in and protected by its material carrier.
Covering and concealment support the idea that real content can remain present without being detached or fully exposed.
Guarding a thing supplies the preserving function of the carrier around its retained content.

changed_reading.before: Evidence is a proposition detached from the event that produced it.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material echo, witnessed content may remain embedded in a preserving scene or medium, and testimony is the act that makes that held content available without denying its carrier.

strongest_changes: The indefinite active-passive pair became a stable witness relation whose occupants can remain open, rather than a riddle requiring one exclusive identification.
The trench sequence turned neutral presence into culpable spectatorship and let the altered scene itself retain evidence.
85:9 and 85:20 expanded local line-of-sight witnessing into exhaustive and circumferential knowledge with no hidden exterior.
The closing recitation, tablet, and preservation sequence changed ephemeral testimony into a record that can cross oral, written, and guarded media.
summary.what_was_special: The most productive activation came from preserving the grammar's open roles while letting context repeatedly alter the witnessing mechanism: indexical, juridical, material, social, temporal, spatial, and archival readings coexist. Split-root images for sky-as-readable-mark and promise-as-counted recurrence produced a particularly non-obvious cosmic-calendar reading without displacing the stronger testimony models.
remaining_uncertainties: The context strongly supplies several witness occupants, but it does not force one of them to exhaust شَاهِد or مَشْهُود.
The role-reversal reading depends on connecting beginning and return to replay of the witnessed violence rather than to a broader cycle.
The emergence-trace and comb-contained-evidence readings are branch-backed but form-distant and should remain explicitly exploratory.
